title: Reformat with `keep-a-changelog`
body:
<!-- Please provide the issue number here if any -->

## Changelog Entry

<!-- Please paste your new entry from CHANGELOG.MD here. Entry is not required for work only related to development purposes. -->

(Reformatted `CHANGELOG.md` using `keep-a-changelog`)

## Description

<!-- Please discuss the changes you have worked on. What do the changes do; why is this PR needed? -->

Using the [`keep-a-changelog`](https://npmjs.com/package/keep-a-changelog) to reformat the document for section ordering and links to release/diff.

## Design

<!-- If this feature is complicated in nature, please provide additional clarifications. -->

## Specific Changes

<!-- Please list the changes in a concise manner. -->

- Run `keep-a-changelog --create --format markdownlint`
- Revert some changes related to wrong indentation
   - We cannot fully embrace `keep-a-changelog` yet, but it's close, at least run it once in a while

<!-- For bugs, add the bug repro as a test. Otherwise, add tests to futureproof your work. -->

- [x] ~I have added tests and executed them locally~
- [x] I have updated `CHANGELOG.md`
- [x] ~I have updated documentation~

## Review Checklist

> This section is for contributors to review your work.

- [x] ~Accessibility reviewed (tab order, content readability, alt text, color contrast)~
- [x] ~Browser and platform compatibilities reviewed~
- [x] ~CSS styles reviewed (minimal rules, no `z-index`)~
- [x] Documents reviewed (docs, samples, live demo)
- [x] ~Internationalization reviewed (strings, unit formatting)~
- [x] ~`package.json` and `package-lock.json` reviewed~
- [x] ~Security reviewed (no data URIs, check for nonce leak)~
- [x] ~Tests reviewed (coverage, legitimacy)~
head: reformat-changelog
